scope: Strict URI-reference resolution and explicit caller-driven redirect/replay coordinator; immutable request snapshots opened over existing TCP/verified HTTPS clients; source candidates only
profile: Follow only 301/302/303/307/308; missing Location is terminal/observable, duplicate Location fails closed
RFC3986 hierarchical references; validate before literal dot removal, preserve escapes, omit fragments; empty-path references retain the base path/query as appropriate
301/302 POST to GET; 303 to GET except HEAD; rewrite drops body/Content-* metadata; preserved unsafe method or nonempty body requires opt-in
Cross-origin default denied; when allowed permanently retain only Accept/Accept-Encoding/Accept-Language/User-Agent plus Content-Type/Encoding for preserved bodies
Strip Connection/hop/proxy fields and Connection-nominated names every hop; never restore credentials when returning to initial origin
HTTPS downgrade always rejected; independent hop bounds stop cycles and empty/fragment-only redirects
Original absolute deadline/shared cancellation covers snapshots and all opens; decision success/failure is checked before publication, first failure remains sticky
Snapshots own borrowed method/field strings and immutable body owners; consumer-retained snapshots are outside chain budgets
Caller associates the correct final response head; on true/error closes old client without body drain/reuse, then selects next transport explicitly; terminal false leaves body observable
Decision cursor performs no transfers and does not aggregate client stats; retain each hop event/error progress; network errors never become redirects/retries
remaining: Automatic-follow facade and mixed-protocol dispatcher acceptance
IDNA/trailing-dot policy, streaming body producers, Expect/early-final handling, cookie/auth refresh and pooling
Deterministic address fallback and broader native/notification/resource/scheduling faults, fuzzing/mobile/macOS-x64 execution
Published compiler/SDK compatibility/promotion, package initial commits/gitlinks/origins/CI/releases
